The annual tuition fee for B.Tech is ₹95,000, and for MBA it is ₹1,20,000. Semester fee is half of the annual fee.
Fees can be paid via the Student Portal using Net Banking, UPI, or Credit/Debit cards. Demand Drafts are also accepted at the Accounts Office.
A late fee penalty of ₹100 per day is charged after the due date. Please pay on time to avoid penalties.
The annual hostel fee is ₹65,000 for Non-AC and ₹85,000 for AC rooms. This includes accommodation, electricity, and internet.
No, the mess fee is separate. The hostel fee only covers accommodation. Mess fee is ₹3,500 per month.
A refundable security deposit of ₹10,000 is required at the time of hostel admission.
Our mess serves 4 meals a day. Breakfast (8-9 AM): Poha/Idli. Lunch (1-2 PM): Roti, Dal, Sabji, Rice. Snacks (5 PM): Samosa/Tea. Dinner (8 PM): Special Curry, Roti, Rice, Dessert.
Yes, the mess serves Non-Veg (Chicken/Egg) twice a week (Wednesday and Sunday). Pure veg options are always available.
You can apply online via our website (admissions.abccollege.edu). Fill the form, upload documents, pay the application fee of ₹1000, and wait for the merit list.
The last date to apply for the upcoming academic year is 15th July. Merit lists will be published on 20th July.
Yes, we offer Lateral Entry (Direct 2nd Year) for diploma holders. Admissions are based on State CET scores.
For B.Tech, candidates must have passed 12th standard with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% for reserved categories).
For MBA, a bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum of 50% aggregate is required, along with a valid CAT/MAT/CET score.
We accept JEE Main and State CET scores for B.Tech. For MBA, we accept CAT, MAT, XAT, and State MBA-CET scores.
B.Tech is a 4-year undergraduate program (8 semesters). MBA is a 2-year postgraduate program (4 semesters).
We offer B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Telecommunication, Mechanical, and Civil Engineering.
Our CSE department is NBA accredited. We offer specializations in AI & Machine Learning, Data Science, and Cyber Security. Average package for CSE is ₹6.5 LPA.
The Principal of ABC College is Dr. Ramesh Kumar. Office hours: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM (Monday-Friday).
Please specify the department. For example: CSE HOD is Dr. Priya Sharma, Mechanical HOD is Prof. Anil Desai.
You can find the official email IDs and cabin numbers of all faculty members on the 'Faculty Directory' page of the student portal.
The Central Library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM (Monday to Saturday). During exam periods, it remains open until 10:00 PM.

patterns: how many books can I issue
response: UG students can issue up to 4 books for 14 days. PG students can issue up to 6 books for 21 days.
A fine of ₹5 per day per book is charged for returning books after the due date.
Our college has a 92% placement record. The Training & Placement Cell organizes recruitment drives, mock interviews, and aptitude training.
The highest package last year was ₹24 LPA (Amazon), and the average package is ₹5.5 LPA.
Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Amazon, Tech Mahindra, and L&T.
Students scoring above 9 SGPA in the previous year are eligible for a 20% tuition fee waiver under the Merit Scholarship Scheme.
We support all State and Central Govt scholarships (EBC, SC/ST/OBC, Minority). Visit the Scholarship Cell in Block B before 31st August.
Mid-semester exams are usually held in October and March. End-semester university exams are held in December and May. Check the portal for exact dates.
Practical exams and viva-voce are conducted one week before the theory end-semester exams.
A minimum of 75% attendance is strictly mandatory for every subject to be eligible to appear for the end-semester exams.
Students with less than 75% attendance are detained and cannot write the university exams. Medical cases require a valid certificate submitted within 3 days.
The college operates from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. Sundays are holidays.
The standard lunch break is from 1:00 PM to 1:45 PM.
We have a fleet of 15 buses covering all major routes in the city. The bus schedule is available at the transport desk.
The transport fee is ₹15,000 per year, payable in two installments.
The nearest metro station is 'City Center Metro', which is 2 km away. Shared autos are easily available.
We have a large cricket/football ground, basketball courts, and an indoor sports complex for badminton, table tennis, and chess.
Yes, an AC gymnasium is available for students from 6:00 AM to 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Membership is ₹1000/year.
Address: ABC Engineering College, Knowledge Park, City. Helpline: +91-9876543210. Email: info@abccollege.edu.
Students must wear the formal college uniform from Monday to Thursday. Friday and Saturday allow smart casuals. ID card is mandatory every day.
Our campus has a strictly ZERO TOLERANCE policy towards ragging. Report any incidents immediately to the Anti-Ragging Helpline at 1800-111-2222.
The campus is completely smoke-free and alcohol-free. Violation will lead to strict disciplinary action including suspension.
The Placement Cell assists pre-final year students in securing 2 to 6-month summer internships in core and IT companies.
To get an NOC for your internship, submit the offer letter to the HOD. The NOC will be issued by the Admin office within 2 working days.
We have active clubs for Coding (ByteClub), Robotics, Drama, Dance (StepUp), and Music. Registrations open every August.
Our annual cultural fest 'Zephyr' and technical fest 'TechNova' are held in February. It's a 3-day mega event!
Our labs are state-of-the-art. We have an Apple Mac Lab, IoT Lab, CNC Workshop, and fully equipped Physics/Chemistry labs.
If you lose your ID card, file a request at the Admin Office with an FIR copy. A duplicate ID fee of ₹250 is applicable.

The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Use your Roll Number as the username to log in to 'ABC-Student-Net'. Speed is capped at 10 Mbps per user.
The Academic Calendar is published on the website. Summer vacation is typically in June. Diwali break is for 7 days.

The college canteen is open from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM offering snacks, thalis, and beverages.
Ample parking space is available for students' two-wheelers. Four-wheeler parking is restricted to staff. Helmet is compulsory for entry.
Our Alumni Association organizes the Global Alumni Meet every December. Connect with seniors via our alumni portal: alumni.abccollege.edu.
